sn47.10:2.1: The sense of _pubbenāpara_ as “than they had before” (literally, “after than before”) is established at [dn26:9.6](), where subjects do not prosper as they had before under a righteous king.
sn47.10:6.2: The Buddha was speaking of “monks” (_bhikkhu_) and “nuns” (_bhikkhunī_) and now returns to the default masculine form _bhikkhu_, which is inclusive of both monks and nuns, and thus rendered with the literal and gender-neutral “mendicant”.
sn47.10:6.3: It’s difficult to get around “fever” here for parilaha, obviously it’s not talking about illness.
sn47.10:8.3: See note on AN 7.61 for pacchapure.
